context: A boss visits the cafe and discusses sales numbers with the owner
purpose: Teach: 鍋/容量/汚れ/売り上げ/取り組む/定着/装備/求人

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 葵さん、お疲れさま。今月の売り上げの数字、ちょっと見せてもらえるかな。
lines.en: Aoi, good work. Could I take a quick look at this month's sales figures?
lines.style: Boss tone, polite but direct authority, warm professional greeting

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、こちらです。先月より売り上げが伸びていて、特にランチの鍋メニューが人気でした。
lines.en: Yes, here you go. Sales are up from last month, and the lunch hot pot menu was especially popular.
lines.style: Calm barista, professional reporting voice with clear delivery

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ、厨房の容量を考えると、これ以上注文が増えると回らなくなるんじゃないか。
lines.en: I see. But considering the kitchen's capacity, won't it get overwhelmed if orders keep increasing?
lines.style: Concerned boss, analytical and thoughtful, raising operational worry

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 実は古い鍋やコンロの油汚れもひどくて、容量の面でも限界に近いんです。
lines.en: Actually, the old pots and stoves have terrible grease stains too, and we're near our capacity limit.
lines.style: Earnest staff, raising practical concerns with concrete examples

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: わかった。厨房の装備を一新する件、本社としても前向きに取り組むよ。
lines.en: Understood. As for fully renewing the kitchen equipment, head office will work on it proactively.
lines.style: Supportive boss, decisive committal tone with clear ownership

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。あと、人手も足りないので、求人を出させてもらえると助かります。
lines.en: Thank you. Also, we're short-handed, so it would help if we could put out a job ad.
lines.style: Polite request, slightly apologetic barista tone with gratitude

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろんだ。新しいスタッフがしっかり定着してくれるよう、研修もちゃんと整えよう。
lines.en: Of course. Let's also set up proper training so the new staff really stick around.
lines.style: Reassuring boss, planning forward warmly with supportive commitment
